'''Kagami-no-Miya Shrine''' (鏡宮神社) refers to Shinto shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Takasaki)|ja|鏡宮神社 (高崎市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Takasaki)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Koyagi-cho, Takasaki City, Gunma Prefecture.
* {{ill|Kagami-no-Miya|ja|鏡宮神社 (伊勢市)|1=Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Naiku)|lt=Kagami-no-Miya Shrine|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagami-no-Miya|13=User:Immanuelle/Kagami-no-Miya Shrine (Naiku)|qq=}} - Located in Asama-cho, Ise City, Mie Prefecture. A branch shrine of the {{ill|Kōtai Jingū|ja|皇大神宮|1=Kōtai Jingū|2=ja|3=皇大神宮|4=zh|5=皇大神宮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Jingū|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}.
